description.narrative:
The overall goal is to contribute towards deepening and enhancing ideological clarity on Transformative Feminist agenda for advancing social, gender equality, women empowerment, and movement building. The Transformative Feminism approach is based on the notion that both women and men are struggling for liberation from patriarchy and other oppressive systems. TGNP will deepen the understanding of Transformative Feminism ideology and catalyze the Transformative Feminism Movement Building with a specific focus on Education, Health, Water, Agriculture, Extractive Industries, Trade & Industry, sectors, as well as Cross-cutting issues. The selected cross-cutting issues including the following: gender-based violence, gender-responsive budgeting, environmental justice, ICT and innovation, participation of women in decision making, and participation of youth, especially, young women and girls as key players. The strategy aims to achieve the following four outcomes: Outcome 1: Increased generation and use of Transformative Feminism knowledge among civil society actors and particularly women rights organizations for evidence-based advocacy, collective organizing for enhanced movement building and public policy influencing
Outcome 2: Strengthened transformative feminism and gender analytical capacity of women leaders and other actors to participate, influence and promote gender equality and social justice at all levels.
Outcome 3: Expanded and strengthened transformative feminist movement spaces and platforms for advancing, gender equality and womens rights
Outcome 4: Enhanced institutional and organizational capacity for further promotion of growth, sustainability and health organization for increased efficiency.

Programmet syftar till att bidra till att fördjupa och stärka ideologisk tydlighet på Transformativ feministisk agenda för att främja social, jämställdhet, kvinnor empowerment och rörelsebyggande. Detta bidrag kommer att fokusera på att fördjupa förståelsen av transformativ feminism ideologi och katalyserar Transformative Feminism Movement Building med ett specifikt fokus på utbildning, hälsa, vatten, Jordbruk, utvinningsindustrier, handel och industri.

The programme aims to contribute towards deepening and enhancing ideological clarity on Transformative Feminist agenda for advancing social, gender equality, women empowerment, and movement building. This contribution will focus on deepening the understanding of Transformative Feminism ideology and catalyze the Transformative Feminism Movement Building with a specific focus on Education, Health, Water, Agriculture, Extractive Industries, Trade & Industry sectors.

tag.narrative: 5.1 - Avskaffa alla former av diskriminering av alla kvinnor och flickor överallt
5.1 - End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere.
5.2 - Avskaffa alla former av våld mot alla kvinnor och flickor i det offentliga och privata rummet, inklusive människohandel, sexuellt utnyttjande och andra typer av exploatering.
5.2 - Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation.
5.3 - Avskaffa alla skadliga sedvänjor, såsom barnäktenskap, tidiga äktenskap och tvångsäktenskap samt kvinnlig könsstympning.
5.3 - Eliminate all harmful practices, such as child, early and forced marriage and female genital mutilation.
5.5 - Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life.
5.5 - Tillförsäkra kvinnor fullt och faktiskt deltagande och lika möjligheter till ledarskap på alla beslutsnivåer i det politiska, ekonomiska och offentliga livet.

5.a - Genomföra reformer för att ge kvinnor lika rätt till ekonomiska resurser, möjlighet att äga och kontrollera mark och andra former av egendom samt tillgång till finansiella tjänster, arv och naturresurser, i enlighet med nationell lagstiftning

5.a - Undertake reforms to give women equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to ownership and control over land and other forms of property, financial services, inheritance and natural resources, in accordance with national laws.
5.b - Enhance the use of enabling technology, in particular information and communications technology, to promote the empowerment of women.
5.b - Öka användningen av gynnsam teknik, i synnerhet informations- och kommunikationsteknik, för att främja kvinnors egenmakt
5.c - Adopt and strengthen sound policies and enforceable legislation for the promotion of gender equality and the empowerment of all women and girls at all levels.
5.c - Anta och stärka välgrundad politik och genomförbar lagstiftning för att främja jämställdhet och öka alla kvinnors och flickors egenmakt på alla nivåer
